whenToUse: States are shown as columns, as on a kanban board.
Files are moved into folders or an upload area.
whenNotToUse: Only the order changes (use a sortable list).
There are many destinations and dragging distances are long (use a move menu).
It often clashes with scrolling on touch screens.

alternatives.name: Sortable List
alternatives.reason: Only reordering within the same list.

accessibility: Each card has a move button, so keyboard and switch users can do the same (WCAG 2.5.7).
Read the result of a move (Design review → Done) with role=status.
Drop columns are named sections, so their positions can be told apart.
Highlights use two cues: color and a dashed border.
